annotations.title: chainpeek: read a contract storage slot (eth_getStorageAt) on Ethereum, Base or Robinhood Chain

description: chainpeek: Read a contract storage slot on Ethereum, Base or Robinhood Chain. For proxy implementation and admin slots use detect_proxy. Returns the 32-byte word at a storage `slot` of a contract (`value`), also as `as_uint` and, when it looks like an address, `as_address`, with `is_zero`; at `latest`, `pending`, `finalized` or a block number. Old blocks need an archive node and may fail. Ethereum, Base and Robinhood only; read-only: nothing is signed or sent. RPC reads are cached up to 30 s. A bad address, hash, hex string, block or range is a 422 before any payment (not charged). Typically under 1 s. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 chain reads per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/ethereum-rpc-reads-api.html
